rationale: The construction is internally consistent and does fix the dead short leg of the parent wedge, but because non-R&D firms are pinned near zero the signal is close to gross profitability (a well-known Novy-Marx anomaly) restricted to R&D firms, so any alpha must be shown to survive controlling for GP itself.

Sign, scaling (non-negative rank weight times signed industry-demeaned net leverage) and hypothesis all line up, and industry-demeaning plus collateral-scarcity weighting is a defensible, non-trivial refinement over the gen-0 level-based collateral ratio, though xrd/sale is fragile for near-zero-sales firms and the industry-relative leverage effect is partly documented.

Mechanically broken long leg: for the majority of firms with xrd always zero, current-minus-five-year-max is exactly 0, which is above the cross-sectional mean and therefore a positive z-score, so the long portfolio fills with high-leverage non-R&D firms rather than the "credible pseudo-distressed innovators" the hypothesis describes.

This is the third rank-wedge in the same family and, like its siblings, the rank difference is near-monotone in R&D-stock-to-assets, so it largely re-expresses the already-tested R&D intensity tilt rather than isolating a distinct accumulated-equity-depletion channel; the authors' own framing concedes it is a near-sibling diagnostic.

target_name: Internal Knowledge Versus Acquired Goodwill Under Debt
rationale: The internal-versus-acquired intangible composition angle is genuinely new relative to the archive, the expression is signed and centered consistently with the stated hypothesis, and the leverage-rank weighting is a real conditioning device — though the composition term is essentially a difference of two separately documented effects (R&D intensity positive, goodwill negative), so an incremental test against those components is warranted.

target_name: Working Capital Coverage Of Research Commitment
rationale: Because xrd is an order of magnitude smaller than lct for nearly all firms, the expression collapses to (act−lct)/lct, i.e. the current ratio minus one — a classic liquidity/solvency screen — so the claimed R&D "interaction" is economically negligible and the signal is effectively a rediscovery of a standard ratio.
